title: CDW Introduces New Capabilities to Help Organizations Realize Value from AI Investments
summary: Unveiled at its 2026 Partner Summit: CDW AI Control Plane , a new capability designed to help organizations evaluate, deploy, govern and optimize AI workloads across models, platforms and environments. CDW AI Elevate , a suite of AI services designed to help midmarket organizations accelerate AI adoption by combining business analysis and AI expertise with Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) teams that help move AI initiatives from concept to production. BuildIQ™ , an AI-native software development platform that helps organizations accelerate application delivery through a governed, AI-assisted development lifecycle. CDW (Nasdaq: CDW), the strategic end-to-end technology partner that turns customer ambition into outcomes, today announced new capabilities designed to help organizations realize greater value from their technology investments and accelerate business and mission outcomes.
